newsitem.title: USA: Dollar jumps on U.S. trade data, hurdles 114 yen.
newsitem.headline: Dollar jumps on U.S. trade data, hurdles 114 yen.

text.p: *Dollar jumps on news of a smaller-than-expected $8.36 bln
U.S. trade deficit in April. Hurdles 114 yen and 1.7360 marks.
*March trade gap revised downward to $7.76 bln from $8.51 bln.
*Weekly jobless claims rose to 347,000 June 14 wk vs 339,000.
*Market awaits French PM Jospin's keynote address at 0900 EDT.
*Ifo W. German business index up at 95.3 in May vs 94.7 April.
